hints.title: Step Length Doubling Cycle
hints.text: The step length in the outward spiral increases by one after every two turns: one, one, two, two, three, three, and so on.

hints.title: Four Directional Sequence
hints.text: Cycle through East, South, West, North directions in order.

hints.title: In-Bounds Collection Filter
hints.text: At each coordinate step, if the point lies inside grid boundaries, append it to the result array until rows times cols points are collected.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def spiralMatrixIII(self, rows: int, cols: int, rStart: int, cStart: int) -> List[List[int]]:
        ans = [[rStart, cStart]]
        dirs = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)]
        d = 0
        step = 1
        r, c = rStart, cStart

        while len(ans) < rows * cols:
            for _ in range(2):
                dr, dc = dirs[d]
                for _ in range(step):
                    r += dr
                    c += dc
                    if 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols:
                        ans.append([r, c])
                d = (d + 1) % 4
            step += 1
        return ans
```
